title: `openai-large` moves to GPT-4.1
summary:
`openai-large` moved to GPT-4.1 while the community project directory grew across creative apps, tools, and a talk on AI governance.

The text API's `openai-large` model now routes to Azure GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-4o mini, with text and image inputs still supported. The advertised model list no longer includes `openai-reasoning`, and referral links are inserted less often.

The project directory added Generator AI Image, MalaysiaPrompt, B&W SVG Generator, and DreamBig. Between them: image generation, prompt conversion, black-and-white vectors, chat, and voice responses.

Strain Navigator, the NetSim web simulator, the Raftar.xyz Discord bot, and the Smpldev app-building platform joined the project listings. Not every Pollinations project needs to look like an image generator.

highlights.title: GPT-4.1 for `openai-large`
highlights.text: Use `openai-large` for GPT-4.1 through the text API. It still accepts text and image inputs. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
